payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-10-18 (GitHub Actions run read reported by the coordinating session; no provider access from this branch): the nightly staging-tenancy.yml workflow shows success, but its harness step actually fails, because continue-on-error applies on schedule runs. Run 39059127896 on 2026-10-17 logged 'GET /api/on-call/services returned 503'. So CME and On Call two-user isolation is still unproven on staging, and stays unproven until staging tracks main or is redeployed to the run's SHA (#057). Next action: deploy one exact candidate to staging and dispatch the workflow from that SHA (a dispatched run fails loudly), per docs/operator-rehearsal-plan.md step 3a.
